seo_title: P&G Philippines Case Study: Search and Meta Ads | SOMIN
description: SOMIN compared P&G, Unilever and Celeteque on Google Search and Meta in the Philippines and found Unilever ran 80.43% of the search text ads.
eyebrow: Brand case study · Personal care · Philippines
h1: For P&G, search still matters, but Meta tensions don't always carry over
h1_em: but Meta tensions don't always carry over
lede: SOMIN compared how P&G, Unilever and Celeteque used Google Search text ads and Meta in the Philippines. Unilever ran 80.43% of the search text ads, pointing traffic to publisher-style content sites.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · May to July 2024 · Philippines

challenge.title: Does Google Search still matter for P&G in the Philippines?
challenge.body: Many brands have moved from content repositories to short-form platforms.

approach.title: Search and Meta content read through the same tensions
points: Catalogued live search text ads by brand and website.
Clustered them into 6 personas and tensions, from Filipino cooking to hair confidence.
Read Meta ads and posts separately.
Turned each tension into ZMOT search experiences.

findings_title: Unilever's search lead and three different Meta playbooks

findings.title: Unilever owns search
findings.body: Its cleanipedia (208) and Allthingshair (155) sites lead; P&G's leaders are Head & Shoulders (45) and Pantene (41).

findings.title: Three Meta playbooks
findings.body: Celeteque relies on diverse Meta ads, Olay runs only ads, with less variation, and Ponds boosts posts for engagement.

findings.title: Radiance drives engagement
findings.body: Radiant skin glow posts drew 1,955,781 engagements from 22 pieces, against 399,517 from 39 on skin concerns and confidence.

delivered.title: Search personas, tension maps and ZMOT keyword lists
points: A search text-ad map by brand and website
Search personas from Healthy Hygiene Enthusiast to Natural Wellness Advocate
Search and Meta tension maps with totals
ZMOT lists per tension, with searchability, queries and keywords
Analyst notes on search behaviour, Meta spending tactics and cross-platform alignment

quote.text: This means that there is room for them to improve their CX by aligning their communications across platforms.

outcome.title: P&G should align its search and Meta tensions
outcome.body: Customer journeys still rely heavily on search, but brands' Meta tensions do not always match their search ones. The ZMOT lists give P&G queries to start aligning them.

faq.q: Which brands and channels were compared?
faq.a: P&G, Unilever and Celeteque on Google Search text ads (live on 15 July 2024), and Celeteque, Olay and Ponds on Meta (May to July 2024).
Search moments linked to each consumer tension, rated for searchability, with example queries and keywords.
It sends search traffic to publisher-style content repositories, an approach many brands have left.
